svg.title: XENA LaaS — Component View v2
svg.desc: Corrected component view. XENALoader contains ParquetReader, ContractValidator, PayloadEnricher, ExecDispatcher. GRIDConnector contains only GRIDInvoker and RetryManager. OutputHandler is a separate Lambda with StatusTracker and ResultHandler. ProgressTracker is Redis ElastiCache outside any Lambda. ErrorHandler is a standalone Lambda. Shared Contract Model at the base. Observability via GETAFE (Openshift).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does ParquetReader extract the contract from S3?')
sendPrompt('What does ContractValidator check in the Parquet contract?')
sendPrompt('What does PayloadEnricher inject into the contract?')
sendPrompt('How does ExecDispatcher enqueue to the SQS grid-queue?')

svg.text: no business logic · passes clientPayload opaquely

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does GRIDInvoker call GRID cross-account?')
sendPrompt('How does RetryManager handle failed GRID invocations?')
sendPrompt('How does StatusTracker monitor job progress via manifest?')
sendPrompt('What does ResultHandler do when manifest signals completion?')
sendPrompt('How does Redis ElastiCache serve as the ProgressTracker — what does it store?')
sendPrompt('What does ErrorHandler Lambda do on validation or execution failure?')
sendPrompt('What is the payload schema enqueued by XENALoader onto grid-queue?')

svg.text: single Parquet file · self-describing · version-pinned · immutable per job

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What fields make up job identity in the XENA contract?')
